verify.method: each act compared this check (100 of 349: a seventh of the held acts, every one within 7 days, and the acts this check wrote) read again from bgs.so.ch (the act document and each version by id); every version held here against the collection's XHTML of the same day, letters and digits (the builder's letters check, ch_cantons.letters_check, so how a parse splits the text into files does not count); and the corpus's newest version rendered by the builder (gitlaw_common) against the files at the tip of main. A difference is corrected by the next check's update when today's parse gives back the act's other held versions exactly; otherwise it is listed for a rebuild decision
